persons.name: Bhāskaramalla
persons.evidence: bhuvanalakṣmisuta bhāskara bhāna yahi dina kayala nāṭaka nilamāna

notes: The chronogram vasu (8) - kara (2) - gaja (8) gives NS 828. In the Maithili signature verse (bhaṇitā), King Bhāskara Malla (son of Queen Bhuvanalakṣmī of Kathmandu) is mentioned as the composer/creator of the drama ('kayala nāṭaka nilamāna' / nirmāṇa). Bhṛṅgin in the subsequent lines is a dramatic character (the gatekeeper of Śiva) entering the scene, not a historical person.
